status: DESIGN - awaiting approval. Proposed HQ home: ArtifactData collection 'model', doc 'latest' (current values) and 'model-weekly/<YYYY-Www>' (history).

conventions.periods: Closed windows only. Daily = previous UK calendar day. Weekly = Mon-Sun ending last Sunday. Monthly = previous calendar month. Rolling-30 = 30 closed days ending yesterday. Rates divide matching windows only.
conventions.base_population: UK human sessions (human_or_bot_session = 'human' AND session_country = 'United Kingdom') for every traffic and conversion rate.
conventions.labels: Each value carries data_quality: VERIFIED (tool pull, source named), PARTIAL (pull works but known gap), ESTIMATE (maths shown), UNKNOWN (input missing).
conventions.last_updated: ISO timestamp written by the run that refreshed the field; null today because the model is not yet running.
conventions.privacy: No customer names, emails, phones or addresses in the model. Order numbers only.

channel_map.description: Normalises old and new UTM values to one channel without rewriting history. First match wins.

rules.channel: Google free listings / feed (may include paid before 28 Sep)

rules.match: utm_source in (facebook, instagram, ig, tiktok, youtube, pinterest, Pinterest, eaglebed_video, eaglebed_cinema) & utm_medium in (social, organic)
rules.sub_channel: utm_source, with ig->instagram, Pinterest->pinterest, eaglebed_video/eaglebed_cinema->unknown platform

rules.match: utm_source=chatgpt.com OR referrer in (chatgpt, perplexity, gemini, copilot)
referrer_name in junk list (syndicatedsearch, googlesyndication, vivoooo, appleeee, ...)
